notes.title: DEMO OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,  the time has come! 
The first demo of Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons is finally out on Steam!  

Venture out into the first area of Ecendeal and fight back the corruption by unleashing the power of the Seasons! 
Of the 3 wardens, 2 are playable in this demo to showcase the different playstyles that each of them brings to the battlefield. 

Completed with an overhauled steam page, a new artwork and new screenhots, we hope that this demo gives you a good first (or second, if you met us at any convention) look of the game. 
As you may have noticed the demo has it's own Steam page seperated from the main game page. This makes it possible for you to leave reviews of the demo.
If you like the demo then we would be very thankful, if you could leave a positive review to give us a better shot at reaching new players!

Should you have any other feedback, issues or bug reports feel free to join our Discord and let us know there or just leave a comment in the community tab.
Thank you so much for your support and patience!

notes.title: Solnox @ Gamescom 2024
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Since our Steam page went live, we've been hard at work refining the look of "Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons" to match our envisioned art style and game feel. We're thrilled with the results and can't wait to present a new playable demo at this year's gamescom!

Yes, you heard that right! We will be at gamescom 2024 as part of the "Home of Indies" in Hall 10.2. 
At our booth, you can not only play "Solnox - Grimoire of Seasons," but also discover four other games from various genres. So make sure to stop by, play some games, and grab some awesome goodies! 

You'll have the opportunity to play two of the four season-based starter decks (for those who were at Caggtus or Indie Game Fest, this might sound familiar) and upgrade them with selectable cards after winning a battle. 
We are already preparing everything for a more extensive demo later this year and can't wait for you to finally play a newer version of the game.

We've also updated the screenshots on the steam page. So definitely check them out. 

We can't wait to see you at gamescom!
